description: Merge two or more caption lines into one. The earliest line survives with the union window and the time-ordered texts joined by spaces; the others are removed. All lines must share one flavour — every one welded to the SAME clip, or every one standalone — and no other caption line on that track may sit inside the merged span (move or include it first).
